content.value: Assume that the distance bętween two points was measured to be 130 mm on (10) a vertical photograph and 350 mm on a map. If the surveying ground distance between the same two points is 7000 m, what will be the photo scale and map scale and the scale reciprocals of the photograph and the map? Provide your judgments on the photo scale and map scale to describe the level of detailing of the photographs.
